title: The Account of the Spilled Beads
youtube_title: The Account of the Spilled Beads | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Isla about account of spilled beads that included how they were found. Isla wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
